newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises firm peak power $3.00/MWh for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises firm peak power $3.00/MWh for Thursday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for firm power during heavy load hours on Thursday by $3.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) and offered no non-firm peak power, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA also reduced the volume of firm power during the heavy load block (hours ending 0700-2200 PST) to 300 MW, compared with 500 MW for the past several days.
Peak power for Thursday was offered at $16.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $17.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Thursday firm off-peak prices unchanged at $10.50 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm power prices during shoulder hours (0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200) were unchanged at $13.00 (Northwest) and $14.00 (COB).
Non-firm power during off-peak hours on Thursday was offered at $10.50 for all deliveries.
BPA also offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Wednesday at $7.00 and $9.00 per MWh.
